items.title: Los Angeles → Seoul
items.detail: KE 012 departs LAX 23:50. In California since the 22nd on the Trybal trip, so nothing to book — just get to the international terminal.

items.title: Seoul → Xi'an, then the city wall
items.detail: KE 141 lands XIY T5 at 11:30. Line 14 to Xi'an North, Line 4 to Dayanta, hotel door. Do NOT buy a Chinese SIM at the airport — a local SIM sits inside the firewall and would kill WhatsApp, which is James's only real channel. Afternoon: drop bags, then the Ming city wall bike ride — Sandra's Xi'an standout and the right thing on a jet-lagged afternoon because it asks nothing of you but pedalling. Y45 for three hours, Y200 deposit, 13.7 km, 2-3 hours. Check both brakes. Evening: Muslim Quarter after dark, a short walk from the wall's north side.

items.title: Terracotta Warriors — and it must be today
items.detail: Morning start: the museum runs 08:30-17:00, not into the evening. Line 3 to Tonghuamen, Line 1 to Fangzhicheng, Line 9 to Huaqingchi exit C, then bus 613 or 602. Two changes, ~Y9, nearer two hours than ninety minutes. Tickets Y120, reserved ahead at bmy.com.cn. Tomorrow is Golden Week day one, so this cannot slip. Evening: the Big Wild Goose Pagoda north square fountain show is five minutes from the Westin.

items.title: Golden Week day one — slow local day
items.detail: Put nothing ticketed or famous here. Shaanxi History Museum is a 15-minute walk and free but ticketed — your release slot is 26 Sep at 17:00 China time. Extended hours through 14 Nov, 08:30-19:00, no weekly closing day, so a failed morning booking can be retried for an evening slot. Fallbacks: Small Wild Goose Pagoda and the Xi'an Museum, free and never sell out. Housekeeping: confirm the permit has physically arrived, and repack for thirty hours on a train.

items.title: Z165 onto the plateau
items.detail: Leave the hotel by 08:00 for a 09:27 departure from Xi'an Railway Station. Checkout is noon so that is no constraint. Off-grid from here until the 10th.

items.title: Tibet — Everest Base Camp tour
items.detail: Eight days with Asia Odyssey, party of five. Full day-by-day with altitudes is under the Tibet tour tab.

items.title: Lhasa → Shanghai
items.detail: MU 2336, 15:30 → 21:50 into Hongqiao. Taxi east to the Disney area, ~Y180-250. Sleep. A designated national make-up workday, so the country is at work the day you land — it will be quiet.

items.title: Shanghai city day
items.detail: Plan B, the recommended shape: put the city on the day the park is fullest. Line 11 to Jiangsu Road, then Line 2 in. Urban Planning Exhibition Center first (free, timed, shut Wednesdays) — its booking for today opens 4 Oct while you are between Shigatse and base camp, so grab it from Lhasa if you have signal. Then the Propaganda Poster Art Centre, 7th floor of 726 Yan'an West Road, Y25, nine minutes from Jiangsu Road. Then the Bund for Art Deco and jazz, and Yu Gardens if there is daylight left.

items.title: Shanghai Disneyland, three weekdays
items.detail: Base or near-base pricing on the emptiest days of the season. Rope drop is the whole game: Zootopia: Hot Pursuit then TRON in the first hour, Pirates of the Caribbean second. Don't plan a Wednesday city day — the Urban Planning Exhibition Center is closed.

items.title: Optional half-day, then home
items.detail: Gates 08:30, out by 15:00, taxi to Pudong for DL 38 at 18:25. Adds one Y475 ticket and turns Plan B into three and a half park days without changing the shape of the trip. Or just Disneytown in the morning and bags at the hotel.
